# Work Item Management

**← Back to [EAP Home](../README.md) • [Foundation](./README.md)**

---

> This document provides essential guidance for work item management using project boards. These boards are powerful tools that help teams manage work using Agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban. They provide a flexible, visual way to plan, track, and discuss work across the EAP development lifecycle.

## 1.0 Key Features of Project Boards

Project boards provide comprehensive work management capabilities through several core features:
page_texts.4:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#11-work-items]

### 1.1 Work Items

- **Purpose**: Track tasks, bugs, user stories, features, and epics
- **Capabilities**: Each item can be customized with fields, tags, and states
- **Benefits**: Provides detailed tracking and categorization of all work types
page_texts.5:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#12-boards-kanban]

### 1.2 Boards (Kanban)

- **Purpose**: Visualize work in progress using customizable columns and swimlanes
- **Capabilities**: Drag-and-drop interface for moving items through workflow stages
- **Benefits**: Clear visual representation of work flow and bottlenecks
page_texts.6:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#13-backlogs]

### 1.3 Backlogs

- **Purpose**: Organize and prioritize work items by sprint, team, or project
- **Capabilities**: Hierarchical view of work with drag-and-drop prioritization
- **Benefits**: Strategic planning and prioritization alignment
page_texts.7:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#14-sprints]

### 1.4 Sprints

- **Purpose**: Plan iterations with capacity tracking, burndown charts, and sprint goals
- **Capabilities**: Time-boxed planning with progress monitoring
- **Benefits**: Predictable delivery cycles and team velocity tracking
page_texts.8:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#15-queries]

### 1.5 Queries

- **Purpose**: Create custom views to filter and report on work items
- **Capabilities**: Advanced filtering, sorting, and custom field combinations
- **Benefits**: Targeted reporting and work item discovery
page_texts.9:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#16-dashboards]

### 1.6 Dashboards

- **Purpose**: Monitor progress with widgets for velocity, burndown, cumulative flow, and more
- **Capabilities**: Customizable widgets and real-time data visualization
- **Benefits**: Executive reporting and team performance insights
page_texts.10:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#20-how-eap-uses-project-boards]

## 2.0 How EAP uses Project Boards

The Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) has adopted specific methodologies and best practices for project board usage to maximize team effectiveness and delivery predictability.
page_texts.11:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#21-kanban-implementation]

### 2.1 Kanban Implementation

- **Approach**: EAP adopted the Kanban team board methodology to visualize workflow and manage work-in-progress limits
- **Visual Management**: Teams use boards to track work items through defined workflow stages
- **Flow Optimization**: Focus on identifying and resolving bottlenecks to improve delivery speed
page_texts.12:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#22-work-in-progress-wip-limits]

### 2.2 Work-in-Progress (WIP) Limits

- **Guideline**: Maintain no more than two user stories in progress simultaneously per team member
- **Exception Handling**: Additional stories may be in progress only when existing work is blocked
- **Benefits**: Reduces context switching, improves focus, and accelerates completion rates
page_texts.13:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#23-team-workflow-standards]

### 2.3 Team Workflow Standards

- **Daily Practice**: Teams review boards during daily standups to identify blockers and progress
- **Sprint Planning**: Use backlogs to plan and commit to work for upcoming iterations
- **Continuous Improvement**: Regular retrospectives to refine board usage and workflow processes
page_texts.14:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#24-reporting-and-metrics]

### 2.4 Reporting and Metrics

- **Velocity Tracking**: Monitor team capacity and delivery predictability over time
- **Cycle Time Analysis**: Measure time from work start to completion for process improvement
- **Burndown Monitoring**: Track sprint progress and identify delivery risks early

[foundation/work-item-management.md#30-work-item-states]

## 3.0 Work Item States

In Azure DevOps, Work Item States represent the lifecycle stages of a work item—such as a user story, bug, task, feature, or epic —as it progresses from creation to completion. These states help teams track progress, manage workflows, and visualize status on boards and backlogs.
page_texts.16:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#31-epic-work-item-states-and-descriptions]

### 3.1 Epic Work Item States and Descriptions

Tracking the Epic through its Lifcycle.

| Valid Values | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Reviewing    | Set EPIC state to Reviewing when - refining understanding of the EPIC- Creating an EPIC hypothesis statement - Establishing preliminary cost estimate and Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF) prioritization. |
| Analyzing    | Set EPIC state to Analyzing when identifying the following: Solution alternatives - Refined cost estimates and WSJF - Define MVP - Create lean business case - Go/No-go decision                             |
| Backlog      | Prioritized EPICS in the Backlog using Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF) when the "Epics Lean Portfolio Management (LPM) field = GO.                                                                        |
| In Progress  | Set EPIC state to In Progress when a child related FEATURE is in Progress.                                                                                                                                   |
| Blocked      | Set EPIC state to BLOCKED when a child related FEATURE is BLOCKED.                                                                                                                                           |
| Done         | Set EPIC state to DONE when all child related work item types (WIT) are in the STATE of DONE.                                                                                                                |
| Cancelled    | Work related to WIT has been indefinitely stopped                                                                                                                                                            |
| Obsolete     | Work related to WIT is no longer valid                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Duplicate    | WIT is a duplicate of an existing work item                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Archived     | [NOT USED]                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
page_texts.17:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#32-feature-work-item-states-and-descriptions]

### 3.2 Feature Work Item States and Descriptions

Tracking the Feature through its Lifcycle

| Valid Values | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Funnel       | The FUNNEL state is the default state when a new FEATURE work item is created. - Epics are decomposed into FEATURES - Features posted in the FUNNEL state have not been refined or finalized in this state. |
| Backlog      | ​Decompose FEATURE into USER STORIES - Refine USER STORIES with development teams - Size User stories                                                                                                       |
| Committed    | FEATURES are committed with confidence vote of 3 or higher Teams commit to deliver the FEATURES by end of the Program Increment Planning (PIP).                                                             |
| In Progress  | Set FEATURE state to In Progress when a child related WIT is in Progress.                                                                                                                                   |
|  Blocked     | ​Set FEATURES and CHANGE REQUESTS state to BLOCKED when a child related User Story is BLOCKED.                                                                                                              |
| Done         | ​​Set Features and Change Requests state to DONE when all child related work item types (WIT) are in the STATE of DONE.                                                                                     |
| Cancelled    | Work related to WIT has been indefinitely stopped                                                                                                                                                           |
| Obsolete     | Work related to WIT is no longer valid                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Duplicate    | WIT is a duplicate of an existing work item                                                                                                                                                                 |
page_texts.18:
[foundation/work-item-management.md#33-story-work-item-states-and-descriptions]

### 3.3 Story Work Item States and Descriptions

Tracking the Feature through its Lifcycle

| Valid Values | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| New          | The NEW state is the default state when a new User Story, User Story or Task work item is created. WITs in this state may still require refinement before being changed to the state of Backlog.                                     |
| Backlog      | Backlog decompose USER STORIES into TASKS - Refine USER STORIES with development teams - Size User stories etc.                                                                                                                      |
| Ready        | Ready represent a state of commitment. Work Items in this state have been refined and placed in an iteration to be completed. This is an active state and work items in this state should be completed during the current iteration. |
| In Progress  | Set User Stories, User Storys and Tasks state to In Progress when a child related WIT is in Progress.                                                                                                                                |
| Build        | [NOT USED]                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Test         | [NOT USED]                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Under Review | Set User Stories state to Under Review when WIT needs review by others.                                                                                                                                                              |
| Blocked      | Set User Stories, User Storys and Tasks to the state of BLOCKED when team members reach a point where they cannot continue until dependencies related to the work items are complete.                                                |
| Done         | Set User Stories, User Storys and Tasks state to DONE when all child related work item types (WIT) are in the STATE of DONE.                                                                                                         |
| Cancelled    | Work related to WIT has been indefinitely stopped                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Obsolete     | Work related to WIT is no longer valid                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Duplicate    | WIT is a duplicate of an existing work item                                                                                                                                                                                          |
